description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultMetadataHeaderKey class, which is an immutable class representing a metadata header key in a JSON path structure. It provides methods for parsing, validation, comparison, and retrieval of the JSON pointer path associated with the header key.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeaderKey
classes.description: Immutable implementation of MetadataHeaderKey, handling JSON pointer paths with specific validation rules and comparison logic.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a character sequence into a DefaultMetadataHeaderKey instance, validating the input string.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DefaultMetadataHeaderKey instance from a given JsonPointer, with validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the JsonPointer path to ensure it adheres to specified rules, such as not containing wildcards at invalid levels.

methods.name: appliesToAllLeaves
methods.description: Checks whether the path applies to all leaves, indicated by a wildcard at the root level.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the relevant JsonPointer path, either the sub-pointer or the entire path.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Provides a comparison method to order MetadataHeaderKey instances based on specific rules relating to wildcards and path specificity.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this instance and another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the path.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the JsonPointer path.
